title: Faded Photo Overview and Six-Step Process
whatItIs: A pale lavender slide with a heavily faded portrait behind a centred indigo app icon with a red badge, a paragraph with phrases in dark navy and light grey, a Design Process pill and six numbered stages in a row.
whatItMeans: A ghosted human photo keeps the focus on the icon while adding warmth, and the six-step row summarises the process at a glance.
techniques: Faded photo as an atmospheric backdrop
App icon with notification badge as the centrepiece
Bold key phrases inside a grey paragraph
Numbered steps in a single row
Dashed line dropping toward the next section

vocabulary.definition: A photo lightened until it becomes a texture.
A small red circle with a count on an icon.
Numbered stage labels laid out horizontally.
